MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released answer key for the posts of Forest Guard and Jail Prahari. This recruitment was released for 1679 posts. Applications for the MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 28 February 2026, to 30 April 2026. The written examination was held on 04 June 2026. Candidates who appeared in this examination this form can download their MPESB Forest Guard & Jail Prahari Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 February 2026
  • Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 April 2026
  • Correction Date : 30 April 2026
  • Exam Date : 04 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 28 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 22 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 60/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
